title: Three Quarters Of Ocean Sharks Now Face Extinction
hook: The sharks still swimming are already the survivors of a collapse.
closing: This is not one failing species; the open ocean is losing its top predators together.
question: Can ocean sharks still recover?

segments.say: Oceanic sharks and rays fell 71% by 2018. Most vanished within a single human lifetime.
Oceanic whitetip sharks fell 98%. The steepest collapse shows how far individual species can fall.
Now 75% of oceanic shark and ray species face extinction. The survivors remain in immediate danger.
